question: The Nagarhole National Park is located in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nagarhole National Park** is located in the state of **Karnataka**, India.
 
• This national park is also known as **Rajiv Gandhi National Park**.
 
• It is part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve and is known for its rich wildlife, including tigers, elephants, and a variety of bird species.
 
• The park is named after the river **Nagarhole** which flows through its rich forest landscape.
 
• It is one of the premier tiger reserves in India and is part of the Project Tiger initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka** is a state in the southwestern region of India, known for its diverse geography and rich cultural heritage.
 
• The state is home to several important national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, including Bandipur National Park, Bannerghatta National Park, and Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
• **Tourism** in Karnataka is well-developed, with attractions ranging from natural landscapes to historical monuments and temples.
 
• The capital city of Karnataka is **Bengaluru**, which is also known as the Silicon Valley of India due to its thriving information technology industry.
 
• Karnataka has a rich history and is known for its contributions to classical music, dance, and literature.
